MappingFields.Name: IND_JURIST
MappingFields.Description: Jurist indicator. Defaults to N; functional authorization remains a manual Key2 Belastingen process.

MappingFields.Name: IND_JB
MappingFields.Description: Key2 Belastingen indicator. Defaults to N; confirm its meaning during implementation.

MappingFields.Name: GEBR_OMS
MappingFields.Description: [Required] User name or description shown in Key2 Belastingen.

MappingFields.Name: GEBR_ORA
MappingFields.Description: [Required] Oracle username from the separate Key2BelastingenOracle target account. Replace Key2BelastingenOracle with the system name of the installed Key2BelastingenOracle target system.

MappingFields.Name: GEBRCODE
MappingFields.Description: [Required][Unique] Internal Key2 Belastingen user code (maximum 6 characters). Generated from the Oracle username; HelloID reruns this mapping with an increased Iteration when the uniqueness check reports a conflict.

MappingFields.Name: INDACTIEF
MappingFields.Description: Account status indicator. J = active, N = inactive.
